title: Karbala se jo kabhi ho ke hawa aati hai
body:
Karbala se jo kabhi ho ke hawa aati hai
Kisi Masoom ki , rone (hichki) ki sada aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Koun sota hai kanaare tere aye nehr-e-Furaat
Teri mitti se abhi boo-e-wafa aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa samajhti hai dulhan laaungi aaya hai shabaab
Sheh samajh te hai ke Akbar ki qaza aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi beemar na padhta ho tahajjud ki namaz
Raat ko bediyo'n ki kyu ye sada aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Haa'n dhadakta na ho marqad me kahi'n qalb e Rubaab
Ali Asghar, Ali Asghar ki sada aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab kabhi zyada mai beemar jo hota hu 'shaheed'
khud ba khud mere lie qaake shifa aati hai
